value: Thinning was observed in the ayahuasca-using group in six cortical areas: the middle frontal gyrus, the inferior frontal gyrus, the precuneus, the superior frontal gyrus, the posterior cingulate cortex, and the superior occipital gyrus. Thickening was found in the precentral gyrus and in the anterior cingulate cortex.

These differences were most prominent in medial parts of the brain, specifically an increase in cortical thickness in the anterior cingulate cortex and a decrease in cortical thickness in the posterior cingulate cortex.
